recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a male figure in urban attire, set against a brushed-metal industrial background with heavy 3D-extruded typography layered across the mid-section.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a riveted metal frame
Foreground 3D text overlapping the subject's torso
High-contrast lighting creating a metallic sheen on skin and surfaces
Symmetrical composition anchored by the subject's pose
coreInvariants: Brushed metal background with visible rivets
Heavy 3D bevel and emboss effects on all text
Cool-toned color palette dominated by silver, blue, and grey
Direct eye contact from the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large 3D display text in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eyes down to the large metallic title, then to the secondary text and background details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject, text, and industrial textures.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Navy Blue (Subject's clothing and beanie)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and Orange (Jersey numbering and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between dark clothing and bright metallic highlights; overall desaturated except for jersey accents.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme 3D extrusion with a top-down perspective
Beveled edges with high-gloss chrome finish
Secondary text features a distressed, stone-like texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are treated as physical objects with depth and shadow
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking a clean chrome 3D font with a textured, distressed version of a similar weight.
graphicDevices: Lens flare highlights on chrome edges

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for heavy 3D extrusion.
Captures the wide, industrial geometric feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a man in a navy blue beanie and jersey, arms crossed, standing in front of a brushed steel wall with rivets in the corners. High contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large 3D chrome-textured all-caps text across the center. The top line should be polished silver; the bottom line should be distressed stone texture. Apply lens flares to the corners of the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the text visibly 3D with depth?
Does the background look like a metal plate?
Is the subject centered and looking at the camera?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress on the secondary text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any specific brand logos on the clothing
Exact wording of the original titles

mustAchieve: Consistent 3D lighting across text and background

postGenerationChecks: Verify the 3D text has a consistent light source
Ensure the rivets are placed symmetrically in the corners
Check that the chrome texture has realistic reflections
Confirm the subject's pose feels grounded behind the text
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Metal + 3D Chrome Typography + Urban Portraiture = Y2K Hip-Hop Aesthetic
